subject.title: fix(doctor): exit non-zero on final invalid config (#77804)

question: Should plain `openclaw doctor` become fail-closed when final persisted configuration remains invalid, or should stable non-zero gating remain exclusive to `doctor --lint`?
rationale: Both behaviors are technically implementable, but changing a shipped CLI exit contract can break existing wrappers and conflicts with the current documented human-versus-automation posture; repository evidence cannot determine maintainer intent. ([docs.openclaw.ai](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor?utm_source=openai))

options.title: Preserve plain-doctor behavior
options.body: Keep plain doctor human-oriented with exit `0`, use the existing lint exit contract for automation, and improve the final human-facing wording if needed.

options.title: Approve fail-closed plain doctor
options.body: Accept the compatibility change, align documentation and upgrade messaging, refresh the branch, and require built-CLI proof for valid and invalid configurations.

recommendation.title: Preserve plain-doctor behavior
recommendation.body: Keep plain doctor human-oriented with exit `0`, use the existing lint exit contract for automation, and improve the final human-facing wording if needed.
